Jamie battles searing pain and a deadly infection from the stingray attack, while all of the camps finally meet and combine map pieces to plan their rescue.

About Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
For the first time ever, 12 Naked and Afraid All-Stars are going overboard. 12 survivalists must dive into the pitch-black sea after they're shipwrecked off the Philippines’ Lost Coast.
